name: Subscription Gifts for WooCommerce
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Subscription Gifts for WooCommerce is WooCommerce Subscriptions addon that implements feature that adds free gift product to a subscription on subscription start or renewal. Can be used with any type of products like simple product, lottery, etc. A must have addon to implement Competition / Giveaway subscriptions with our Lottery plugin and Pick Number addon. Reward your loyal subscribers by effortlessly adding free gifts to their WooCommerce Subscriptions.

Prerequisites

  • WooCommerce
  • WooCommerce Subscriptions

Features

  • Add any type of product to user with active subscription
  • Add gift on subscription start or renewal
  • Trivial to use and setup

Use Cases

  • Competition subscriptions
  • Gift and reward your subscribers
  • Extend subscriptions with gift on subscription start, renewal or both

PRO Features

All features of the free version, plus:

  • Add gift both on start and on renewal
  • Quantity for product that is gifted in subscription
  • Premium support: Direct access to our ticket support system at https://wpgenie.org/support/
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or greater

Setup

This section describes how to install Subscription Gifts for WooCommerce plugin and get it working.

  1. Make sure that WooCommerce and WooCommerce Subscriptions (this plugin will not work without WooCommerce Subscriptions) are installed and working.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

If you have any problems contact us at http://wpgenie.org/
